revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Replaced discretionary "when necessary" scope language with objective criteria defining when process validation is required (output cannot be fully verified by subsequent inspection, monitoring, or measurement); added documented justification requirement when validation is not performed; 21 CFR 820 section 820.75 citation updated to QMSR with ISO 13485 clause. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 10; IA-2025 OFI 8.
